telemetry-default.rationale: The app discloses installation/heartbeat telemetry and crash reports, plus separate opt-in usage events. Official packaged builds enable anonymous install/heartbeat telemetry and crash reports by default. Identified usage analytics are opt-in; unpackaged development builds send none. Settings General Privacy has Usage data levels and a separate crash-report switch. Environment overrides can stop all collection. An in-app Privacy setting can switch usage data off, and a separate in-app switch disables crash reports. DO_NOT_TRACK=1 is an overriding process-environment route.
